import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def mk(h,w,rect,markers):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    (r0,r1,c0,c1)=rect
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=2
    for r,c,v in markers: g[r][c]=v
    return g
